verdict.rationale: Asana documents several first-party ways to carry context across tools and agents. AI Teammates use shared memory and Work Graph context so 'no one repeats context they've already given' (asana-docs-5, asana-docs-12). An official MCP server brings the work graph into Claude and other AI clients (asana-docs-37, asana-docs-38, asana-probe-3), and two-way data sync integrations cover Jira, GitHub, GitLab and others (asana-intdir-15, asana-intdir-13), with PagerDuty incidents created carrying task context (asana-intdir-28). missing for 10: an explicit documented agent-to-agent handoff mechanism showing what context transfers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that context is not lost in practice.
